description: Hello! We’re Mario, Víctor, Eduardo and Belén, a multidisciplinary team from different parts of Spain. None of us are aerospacial experts, but we’re really excited to take on the NASA Flame in Freefall challenge! Fire behaves very differently without gravity, and that matters as we plan to live on the Moon and Mars. This weekend we’ll dive into NASA’s combustion data and try to turn it into something useful for keeping astronauts, and people on Earth, safe. Good luck to everyone!
